title: Rekka no Omoi
originalTitle: 烈火の懐（れっかのおもい）
summary: A compact character-by-character film guide covering the Troopers and some of the four Warlords. It includes Norio Shioyama drawn art, mini-manga, and a final-episode digest. The original note remembers buying it while hungry for new Troopers material after the broadcast ended.
